jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Technical sales professional, owning the Cisco brand with customers and partners. Provides technical solutions to address customer and partner business needs. Collaborates with the account team and connected sales teams on the customer plan, jointly ensuring customer success. Serves as an expert or trusted technical advisor by the account team and customer/partner.
  
  
**What we are looking for:**  

* Specialization and Focus - Strong knowledge of Cisco’s portfolio, including specialized/architecture perspective, increases penetration via cross/up-selling and displaces competition, Owns technical relationship with customer(s)/partner(s)
* Customer Engagement and Accountability - Leads engagements with IT& decision makers at customer/partner and LOB interaction, Knowledgeable of customer environment and market, including competitor plays, Primary technical sales influencer, translates customer/partner business need into technical requirements

The Internal Sales Process, most selling time spent landing opportunities and expanding within an account, Involved in customer strategic planning
  

* Corporate Interlock - Provides active feedback to BEs and relevant sales teams on strategic customer needs and market opportunities, and competitive market tactics
* Typical Sales Cycle - Takes the lead on moving deals across technical sales process, Designs and presents relevant solution based on technical and business requirements identified by the customer or partner, manages virtual support team of sales resources, leverages relevant tools and resources to support a deal
* Success Measures - Increase revenue: Closed opportunities converted to closed deals, displace a competitor/increased market share, increase net new customers on a quarterly basis

**What You'll Do:**  

* Leads multi-year strategic plans by integrating Cisco’s portfolio with its ecosystem and partner network
* Leverages deep expertise of Cisco’s portfolio to create new knowledge and collaborates with engineering to shape future products
* Leads organizations’ technical strategy as a trusted technology and business advisor to C-suite executives
* Unifies customer’s business vision with emerging industry trends to develop cross-architecture solutions
* Leads disruptive cross-architecture roadmaps for customers
* Conceives the overarching vision for demand generation and enablement imperatives
* Unlocks customer’s untapped market potential through cross-architecture strategies
* Steers demonstrations to showcase tailored solutions, driving transformation and meeting key business objectives
* Utilizes advanced competitive intelligence to drive sustainable market advantage for Cisco
* Unifies and integrates a diverse coalition of stakeholders to drive synergies and cultivate deep, enduring customer relationships
* Shapes SE teams, engineering teams and leadership to develop innovative knowledge-sharing frameworks, and steer cross-functional educational strategies
* Drives organizational agility by developing GTM-wide market adaptation strategies

**Minimum Qualifications:**  
Bachelors + 12 years of related
  
experience, or
  
Masters + 8 years of related
  
experience, or
  
PhD + 5 years of related experience
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

monari GmbH is a dynamic and innovative fashion brand dedicated to creating stylish and high-quality ready-to-wear outfits for fashion-conscious women. As a company that values creativity, quality, and customer satisfaction, monari has established itself as a trusted name in the fashion industry. With a strong presence through monari-stores and a focus on personal customer interactions, the company emphasizes a blend of modern design and excellent service. monari GmbH prides itself on fostering a positive work environment that encourages growth, collaboration, and innovation. The company is committed to sustainable practices and continuously seeks to enhance its offerings and operational processes to meet the evolving needs of its customers and employees.

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled .NET Backend Developer (m/w/d) to join our team at the Gronau headquarters. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining our backend systems that support various digital platforms, including our hybrid showroom and Händler-App. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the performance, security, and scalability of our applications. The ideal candidate will have a passion for technology, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to innovative projects within a supportive environment that values professional development and work-life balance.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess a relevant qualification in software development, computer science, or a related field, complemented by practical experience in backend development. Proven expertise in C#, .NET Core, and SQL is essential. Familiarity with frameworks such as SignalR and experience with version control systems like Git are highly desirable. Candidates should have a solid understanding of agile development methodologies, including SCRUM and Kanban, and demonstrate enthusiasm for emerging technologies and continuous learning. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively within a team are also important attributes for this role.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain backend systems, including our hybrid showroom and dealer applications.
Create and optimize high-performance web APIs using C# and .NET Core frameworks.
Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure code quality, security, and adherence to best practices.
Maintain and enhance database systems, ensuring data integrity and performance.
Collaborate with front-end developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver seamless solutions.
Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends and incorporate innovative technologies into projects.

Benefits

monari GmbH offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and development of its employees. These include a competitive salary aligned with industry standards, Christmas and holiday bonuses, and 30 days of vacation annually. Employees enjoy a flexible work environment with hybrid working arrangements, combining office presence at the headquarters with mobile working options. The company provides daily warm meals, a fresh salad bar, and a variety of free beverages to promote a healthy and enjoyable workplace. Additional perks include participation in the Jobrad program, access to corporate benefits, a dedicated employee app, regular team events, and special initiatives such as Tuesday breakfasts and after-work social activities. monari GmbH is committed to creating a motivating and rewarding environment that fosters both personal and professional growth.

Equal Opportunity

monari GmbH is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our hiring practices are based solely on qualifications, experience, and merit. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances creativity, innovation, and overall company success, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees.

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer (gn)
jobs.description:
Job Function

Services

Warum SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne ist ein globaler Anbieter für Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Mit einer Präsenz in über 70 Ländern und mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitenden unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Software-Investitionen zu optimieren, Anwendungen zu modernisieren und das volle Potenzial von Cloud, Data und AI zu erschließen.

Was uns ausmacht, sind die Menschen bei SoftwareOne. Wir ermöglichen Zusammenarbeit über Ländergrenzen hinweg, fördern kontinuierliches Lernen und schaffen Raum für Entwicklung in einer sich ständig wandelnden Technologielandschaft. Ob dein Fokus auf Technologie, Customer Success oder Business Operations liegt – deine Ideen zählen und dein Beitrag macht einen Unterschied.

Werde Teil eines globalen Teams, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten weiterentwickelst, mit führenden Technologien arbeitest und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffst.

Die Rolle

Suchst du eine Rolle, in der du dich tief auf komplexe Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen spezialisieren und technische Entscheidungen prägen kannst?
Möchtest du nicht nur „Tickets abarbeiten“, sondern langfristig Kundenumgebungen mitgestalten, modernisieren und sicherer machen?
Bist du bereit in Enterprise Azure Umgebungen unserer Kunden der wirklich Wirkung zu erzielen?

Praktische Informationen

Standort:
Bundesweit, Deutschland | Arbeitsmodell:
Hybrid / Remote mit Vor-Ort-Einsätzen | Sprachen
:
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse | Umfang:
Vollzeit | Rufbereitschaft und gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Einsätze

Unser Team Hybrid Managed Service stellt die Leistungsfähigkeit der IT-Infrastrukturen unserer Kunden sicher. In maßgeschneiderten Setups übernehmen wir den Betrieb verschiedener Infrastrukturdienste und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in den Bereichen Data Center, Storage, Backup, Windows, Linux, Virtualisierung sowie im Infrastruktur Support.

Als Azure Cloud Engineer (gn) übernimmst du technische Verantwortung für geschäftskritische Managed-Service-Umgebungen auf Microsoft Azure. Du stellst den stabilen, sicheren Betrieb sicher, analysierst Störungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Cloud-, Infrastruktur- und Entwicklungsteams nachhaltige Verbesserungen.

Deine Aufgaben

Betrieb, Monitoring und Optimierung komplexer Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen
Analyse und Behebung anspruchsvoller Incidents sowie Ableitung nachhaltiger Maßnahmen
Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mit PowerShell, Bash und Azure Runbooks
Administration von Azure-Netzwerken, virtuellen Maschinen, Datenbanken, Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Richtlinien
Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Logging, Dokumentation und Knowledge Base
Mitarbeit an Infrastructure-as-Code-Themen, insbesondere Terraform
Teilnahme an Vor-Ort-Terminen, Supporteinsätzen und 24/7-Rufbereitschaft

Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten

Du bringst eine Eigenverantwortliche, proaktive und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Technologien und angrenzende Applikations- oder Web-Service-Themen einzuarbeiten. Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb komplexer Microsoft-Azure-Umgebungen mit und hast Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen:

Technische Schwerpunkte

Azure Infrastructure: Subscriptions, Management Groups, VMs, Netzwerke, Firewalls, VPN, Application Gateway, Private Endpoints und DNS
Azure Operations: Resource Health, Monitoring, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Update Manager und Maintenance Configurations
Datenbanken und Plattformdienste wie Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Web Apps, Container Apps und Container Registry
Identity & Security: Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management und AD-Synchronisierung
Grundkenntnisse in Azure DevOps, insbesondere Repositories, Pipelines und Service Connections

Betriebssysteme und Automatisierung

Erfahrung mit Windows Server sowie Grundkenntnisse in Linux, idealerweise Red Hat Enterprise Linux oder Ubuntu
Scripting- und Automatisierungskenntnisse mit PowerShell und Bash
Kenntnisse in Kusto Query Language, JSON, ARM Templates sowie Interesse an Terraform
Kenntnisse in Active Directory Domain Services und DNS

Das haben wir zu bieten

Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind unser wichtigstes Kapital und wir setzen alles daran, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst:  

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten  
30 Urlaubstage sowie die Option auf ein Sabbatical  
Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliches Coaching und Beratung  
Engagement für Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit durch unsere DEIB-Strategie und Initiativen  
Gesundheits- und Sportangebote (z.B. Wellpass) sowie Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge  
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Mitarbeitendenaktien, Empfehlungsprogramm und Corporate Benefits  
Angenehme Arbeitskultur mit freiem Dresscode und strukturiertem Onboarding inklusive Buddy 

Alle weiteren Benefits unter:  hier  

Interessiert?

Dann bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und wenigen Klicks über unser Online-Formular! Es ist kein Anschreiben nötig. 

Inklusion und Unterstützung

SoftwareOne lädt Menschen jeglicher Herkunft und mit unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten herzlich dazu ein, sich bei uns zu bewerben. Solltest du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Anpassungen benötigen, sende uns bitte eine E-Mail an hier . Bitte gib dabei die Position an, für die du dich bewirbst, sowie das Land, in welchem du wohnst. Ein Mitglied unseres Teams, das nicht am Entscheidungsprozess beteiligt ist, wird sich mit dir in Verbindung setzen, um deine spezifischen Bedürfnisse zu besprechen. Wir werden unser Bestes tun, um dir entgegenzukommen. Alle von dir geteilten Informationen werden sicher aufbewahrt und gemäß den Bestimmungen der Datenschutz-Grundverordnung (DSGVO) streng vertraulich behandelt.

Wir bei SoftwareOne verpflichten uns, ein Umfeld mit gegenseitigem Respekt zu schaffen. Allen Bewerbenden und Teammitgliedern sollen gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten geboten werden und das unabhängig von Ethnie, Hautfarbe, Religion, Alter, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung, genetischer Veranlagung, geschütztem Veteranenstatus, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, oder jedes andere Merkmal, welches unter gesetzlichem Schutz steht. Zudem laden wir Berufs-Wiedereinsteiger ein, die nach einer geplanten Auszeit in die Berufswelt zurückzukehren möchte, unser SOAR Programm zu erkunden.

Skills zu dieser Stellenanzeige: Services, DevOps, Linux, service-management, Service-management, Servicemanagement, servicemanagement, Datenbank, webservice, Webservice, Support, support, Systemingenieur, IT-administration, it-administration, Azure, Container-Virtualisierung, IT-Administrator, it-administrator und Servicemanager

jobs.title: Bouvet søker utviklere, techleads og arkitekter med erfaring fra .NET og KI
jobs.description:
Vi leter etter deg som er genuint opptatt av å lage gode produkter og ønsker å gjøre dette sammen med engasjerte og delingsglade likesinnede!

Greit å vite før du leser videre:

Er du dyktig skal det ikke være komplisert å søke jobb hos oss. Alt vi trenger er en CV, deretter velger du din foretrukne møteplass for fagsamtale der vi blir kjent. Enten det er Teams, kaffebar, lunsj eller på kontoret hos oss. Vi respekter din travle hverdag og sender ikke med oppgaver utenfor selve intervjuet.

Om rollen din i Bouvet:

Bouvet er det største norskeide IT-konsulentselskapet og har et av de fremste .NET miljøene i landet med flere hundre utviklere totalt. I Oslo er vi en kompetent gjeng på i overkant av 80 konsulenter som kjennetegnes av nysgjerrighet, raushet og faglig integritet. Vi pleier å si at vi ønsker å vokse forsiktig. Vi tror på gode matcher og langsiktighet.

Vi jobber daglig med de største kundene og viktige og samfunnsnyttige løsninger og har et av landets aller beste og mest anerkjente Microsoft fagmiljø. Hos oss vil du mest sannsynlig inngå i et tverrfaglig team bestående av team/prosjektleder, arkitekt, interaksjonsdesigner, grafisk designer og utviklere. Vi vektlegger at våre utviklere i tillegg til å utvikle og sette opp løsningene, også har forretningsforståelse. På denne måten vil du kunne delta i rådgivende rolle. Det vil også være en fordel om du forstår hvordan KI kan gi mer verdi både for kunden og i utviklingsprosessen.

Faglig vil du ofte være i nærheten av C# (.NET), KI-verktøy, Azure og web, uten at det er en begrensning. Vi er alltid nysgjerrige på nye teknologier. Vi liker å løfte produkter for å skape merverdi og gode opplevelser for brukerne hos våre kunder. Bruk av KI som teknisk verktøystøtte gir økt effektivitet og skaper nye muligheter.

Om deg:

Vi ser etter deg som:

Har minimum 4 års relevant erfaring som utvikler, arkitekt eller techlead og har jobbet med: .NET-utvikling (C#) - frontend/backend eller fullstack-utvikling fra et eller flere prosjekter
Trives med å forstå helheten i komplekse utfordringer og kan konkretisere og formidle dette for kollegaer og kunden
Deler av vår kundeportefølje krever sikkerhetsklarering, så det er et krav at du kan bli sikkerhetsklarert
Er nysgjerrig, med et ønske om å styrke vår felles kompetanse og til å utvikle konsepter og verktøy
Har gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig (minst B2 nivå)

Vi setter også stor pris på om du:

Har kompetanse og erfaring med bruk av KI verktøy i utviklingsfasen
Har erfaring med eller god kjennskap til databasesystemer, smidig utviklingsmetodikk og skyløsninger

eller har kjennskap til disse og ønsker å lære mer om det.

Det er også en fordel med kjennskap (eller interesse for å bli bedre) innen: Design Patterns Docker, kubernetes og andre systemer og verktøy for containerisering

Vi tilbyr:

Solid norskeid og regionalt styrt organisasjon med kort vei til beslutninger og mulighet til å påvirke hverdagen
En arbeidsgiver som jobber hardt for å skaffe spennende kunder og oppdrag både i privat og offentlig sektor
En hverdag tilpasset et hektisk familieliv med mye fleksibilitet.
Et av de beste fagmiljøene i Norge
Utviklingsmulighetene er gode – du får de utfordringene du vil ha, og kolleger og ledere støtter deg underveis.
Vi legger vekt på faglig utvikling for den enkelte, støttende samarbeid og kompetansedeling.
Mulighet for eierskap i egen bedrift gjennom aksjeprogram
Konkurransedyktige betingelser med attraktiv overskuddsdeling

Kjenner du deg igjen i noe av dette? Håper vi ses til en smidig ansettelsesprosess slik vil selv ville hatt den!
